title: explicit co-ligand check (optional) and paper rewrite

conventions.purpose: common-background explicit ligand check; promote only at >=9/12 complete Li pairs and 48/48 production ensembles
conventions.medium: same SMD acetonitrile, same stoichiometry across samples
conventions.comparison: redox difference of different conditional species; not a Boltzmann average of bare cluster G
conventions.scope: does not model a real coordination population; not part of the first mandatory loop
